baseline.name: Research Ethics
baseline.scope_notes: Research ethics, scientific integrity, research regulation and ethics-review processes. Theoretical original articles and critical reviews allow work based on existing evidence; new clinical studies are unnecessary. Original empirical articles normally have a 7,000-word limit, theoretical articles 5,000, and reviews 3,000–6,000. Letters receive editorial review and are not automatically peer-reviewed research articles. An AI statement is mandatory in every submission, including an explicit statement of no AI use where applicable. Preprints are accepted but must not be updated during review; accepted work requires a final-publication link. The journal-specific AI statement requirement is stricter than Sage's general assistive-editing disclosure exemption.

route.conditions: The current journal-specific Community Open Access policy states no cost to authors or readers and no APC after acceptance, without an institutional-affiliation condition. All submissions require an AI-use or no-use statement before references. An older official PDF still quotes an APC; the current named Community OA policy controls this recorded route. Recheck the current sponsorship/policy before submission.
